sentences.text: The Chicago White Sox are an American professional baseball team based in Chicago , Illinois .	baseball	baseball

The White Sox compete in Major League Baseball -LRB- MLB -RRB- as a member club of the American League -LRB- AL -RRB- Central division .	Major League Baseball	Major League Baseball	American League	American League	Central	National League Central
The White Sox play their home games at Guaranteed Rate Field , located on the city 's South Side .	Guaranteed Rate Field	Guaranteed Rate Field	South Side	South Side, Chicago

They are one of two major league clubs in Chicago ; the other is the Chicago Cubs , who are a member of the National League -LRB- NL -RRB- Central division .	Central	National League Central	Chicago Cubs	Chicago Cubs	National League	National League
The team is currently owned by Jerry Reinsdorf .	Jerry Reinsdorf	Jerry Reinsdorf

One of the American League 's eight charter franchises , the Chicago team was established as a major league baseball club in .	baseball	baseball	American League	American League	franchises	Major North American professional sports teams
The club was originally called the Chicago White Stockings , but this was soon shortened to Chicago White Sox .

The team played home games at South Side Park before , in , moving to Comiskey Park for the next eight decades .	Comiskey Park	Comiskey Park	South Side Park	South Side Park	South Side	South Side, Chicago
